title: Heves'in Minik Kıvılcımı
author: Yasemin Erkek
description:
Heves is bursting with energy and loves trying new things, from piano and gymnastics to painting. Yet, just like a flickering flame, her initial excitement quickly fades whenever things get difficult, leaving her ready to give up.

Determined to find out why, Heves turns to her book-loving mother, her baking-enthusiast father, her friends, and the hardworking artisans in her neighborhood. Through their stories, she discovers a heartwarming truth: everyone’s "tiny sparks" dim from time to time, and only persistence and the courage to keep trying can turn them into lasting, bright glows. Inspired by this realization, Heves looks inward to uncover her own true passion, science experiments.

Blending expressive, playful illustrations with an empowering growth-mindset message, Little Sparks of Curiosity reassures young readers that true joy lies not in instant perfection, but in never giving up on what makes them shine.
